value.title: Episode 1
value.synopsis: Haru works as a maid for the Miyanomori family. The head of the clan is a powerful man in Japan in the Taisho Era. He has six sons from different wives and he will name the heir of whoever makes him the happiest.

value.title: Episode 2
value.synopsis: Haru works hard as maid for the Miyanomori family and her relationship with the six brothers become more difficult.
